sources.title: DefiLlama — Hyperliquid protocol: fees, revenue, TVL, OI, methodology
sources.excerpt: Fees 30d $85.36M, annualised $906.89M. Revenue 30d $68.5M, annualised $690.28M, cumulative $1.359B; revenue = holders revenue. Revenue is mostly Assistance Fund buybacks (99% of perp/spot fees net of builder fees) plus ~90% of AQAv2 USDC reserve yield (since 27 Aug 2026) and spot-deployer auction burns: Q3-26 revenue $173.97M, of which buybacks $151.34M, reserve yield $22.16M, burns $0.47M. Perp volume 30d $212.1B; OI $7.495B; TVL $8.433B. Incentives: $0.

sources.title: Tokenomist — Hyperliquid allocation, vesting and unlock tracking
sources.excerpt: Future emissions 38.888%, genesis airdrop 31.0% (unlocked 29 Nov 2024), core contributors 23.8% (1-year lock from 29 Nov 2024, then 24 months linear, ceiling ~9.92M HYPE/month), Foundation 6.0%, community grants 0.3%. Actual monthly claims far below the ceiling (e.g. Nov-25 1.75M, Feb-26 0.14M, Oct-26 3.75M). Next unlock 6 Nov 2026.

sources.title: The Block — Hyperliquid genesis event and allocation (28 Nov 2024)
sources.excerpt: Team statement: no allocations for private investors, centralized exchanges or market makers.

sources.title: Staking Rewards — Hyperliquid staking
sources.excerpt: 442.14M HYPE staked (46.51% staking ratio), reward rate 2.23%, 27 validators. Implied staking emission ≈ 9.86M HYPE/yr.

sources.title: Hyperliquid docs — Staking
sources.excerpt: Reward rate 2.37% at 400M staked, scaling with 1/sqrt(total stake). Validator self-delegation minimum 10k HYPE locked 1 year. No automatic slashing; validators can vote to jail peers.

sources.title: crypto.news — HYPE price falls despite $1.36B in buybacks
sources.excerpt: Assistance Fund has spent $1,364,831,403.93 buying 48,000,102.51 HYPE (13 Oct 2026).

sources.title: Coinpaprika — Hyperliquid revenue keeps falling
sources.excerpt: Buybacks: Q3-25 ~$290M, Q2-26 ~$149M, Q3-26 $151.34M (+1.6% QoQ, −48% YoY). Gross fees Q3-25 ~$357M → Q3-26 ~$183M. HIP-3 builder fee-sharing raised cost of revenue to 18% in Q2-26.

sources.title: 21Shares — Hyperliquid fees and revenue, H1 2026 (ETF issuer: has a commercial interest)

insider_allocation_pct.note: core contributors 23.8% + Foundation 6.0%; no investor allocation

unlock_12m_pct_of_circ.note: contractual ceiling: 12 × 9.917M / 222.446M. At the October claim pace (3.75M/month) it would be 20.2%. Ceiling used, because the team can claim it.

price_to_last_round_multiple.note: no private round was ever sold, so there is no investor cost basis to overhang the market

annual_inflation_pct.note: staking emission ~9.86M HYPE/yr (H05) minus buybacks ~8.85M HYPE/yr ($690M annualised revenue at ~$78, H02) = ~1.0M net, ≈0.45% of circulating. Excludes contributor unlocks (see K04).

annualized_revenue_usd.note: holders revenue: buybacks + USDC reserve yield + auction burns (Q3-26: $151.3M + $22.2M + $0.5M)

incentives_to_revenue.note: no usage incentives. Staking emissions (~$760M/yr at current price) are a security budget, roughly offset by buybacks — see K08
